issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

credentials.description: Contains the access key and secret key.

defaultGroupId.description: The default group id to add IAM users to.

MAX_ACCOUNT_COUNT.description:
The maximum number of service accounts created through platform that should exist in the project.
The 100 service account limit for the project should not all be used up for developers.

credentialPerProject.description:
Map of project id -> access token string of admin user in the project.
The access tokens are generated through gcloud CLI for the provSecret admin accounts in the project.
